author: MLGtino
body:
Hi, first of all, here's my channel trailer in case you were interested.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BL1VJVnLpmw&feature=youtu.be
Next order of business:
This is now a shared account. If I'm on Avicus, it won't be  me 60% of the time. The person taking over is pretty good at PvP and I've been friends with him for long enough now to entrust him to get me up to 100,000 kills (kinda lost all motivation once Sunrise came up to 99,000 kills). I'll still be on the forums, but I can't put up with targeting and lag anymore.
Anyways, enjoy and good-bye for now. 
(I'll be here for tonight's event however).
